fact: INSTAT's Annuaire statistique du Mali 2024, dated April 2026, publishes health tables sourced to the SNISS 2020-2023 yearbooks and the 2024 hospital yearbook, justice tables sourced to the justice planning unit's activity reports, and police road-accident tables; it gives no statement that the figures are drawn from records (conservative: source named only).
title: Annuaire statistique du Mali 2024
